Together, we’re integrating Sky’s deep macOS capabilities into ChatGPT to make AI more intuitive, contextual, and action-oriented.

articles.title: The CMA’s designation of Google’s mobile ecosystem
articles.summary: We are disappointed by the CMA’s designation of an open mobile ecosystem with strategic market status.
